name: Riptide
text:
Whenever you play a card from hand, you may put a card from hand face down into your arsenal.
Whenever a trap you control triggers, deal 1 damage to the attacking hero.

name: Barbed Castaway
text:
Once per Turn Instant - {r}: You may put an arrow card from your hand face up into your arsenal.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}: You may turn a face down arrow in your arsenal face up. If you do, put an aim counter on it.

name: Driftwood Quiver
text:
Riptide Specialization
Instant - Destroy Driftwood Quiver: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck.

name: Mask of Malicious Manifestations
text:
Action - {r}, put a card from your hand or arsenal on the bottom of your deck, destroy Mask of Malicious Manifestations: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal an attack action card. Put it into your hand, then shuffle. Go again
Blade break

name: Threadbare Tunic
text: Instant - Destroy Threadbare Tunic: Gain {r}. Activate this ability only if you have no cards in hand.

name: Toxic Tips
text:
Action - {r}, destroy Toxic Tips: The next attack action card you play this turn gains "When this hits a hero, create a Frailty, Inertia, or Bloodrot Pox token under their control." Go again
Blade Break

name: Ironrot Legs
text: Blade Break

name: Bloodrot Trap
text: When this defends and the attacking hero has played or activated a reaction this chain link, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

name: Frailty Trap
text: When this defends an attack with go again, create a Frailty token under the attacking hero's control.

name: Inertia Trap
text: When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, create an Inertia token under the attacking hero's control.

name: Boulder Trap
text: When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, put a -1{d} counter on an equipment the attacking hero controls.

name: Pendulum Trap
text: When this defends and the attacking hero has played or activated a reaction this chain link, put the top 2 cards of their deck into their graveyard.

name: Tarpit Trap
text: When this defends an attack with go again, the next time an attack action card hits this turn, effects don't trigger.

name: Falcon Wing
text:
If Falcon Wing has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
Go again

name: Hemorrhage Bore
text: If Hemorrhage Bore has an aim counter, it has "When this hits a hero, destroy a card in their arsenal."

name: Murkmire Grapnel
text:
If Murkmire Grapnel has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
Damage that would be dealt by Murkmire Grapnel can't be prevented.

name: Salvage Shot
text: When this hits, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck.

name: Searing Shot
text: If Searing Shot hits a hero, they lose 1{h}.

name: Sedation Shot
text:
If Sedation Shot has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, create an Inertia token under their control.

name: Withering Shot
text:
If Withering Shot has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, create a Frailty token under their control.

name: Ravenous Rabble
text:
When this attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. This gets -X{p}, where X is the pitch value of the card revealed this way.
Go again

name: Increase the Tension
text:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p} and "Defense reactions can't be played from hand this chain link."
Go again

name: Scout the Periphery
text:
Look at the top card of target hero's deck.
The next attack action card you play from arsenal this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

name: Falcon Wing
text:
If Falcon Wing has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
Go again

name: Infecting Shot
text:
If Infecting Shot has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

name: Murkmire Grapnel
text:
If Murkmire Grapnel has an aim counter, it has +1{p}.
Damage that would be dealt by Murkmire Grapnel can't be prevented.

name: Scout the Periphery
text:
Look at the top card of target hero's deck.
The next attack action card you play from arsenal this turn gains +2{p}.
Go again

name: Bloodrot Pox
text: At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Bloodrot Pox, then it deals 2 damage to you unless you pay {r}{r}{r}.

name: Frailty
text:
Your attack action cards played from arsenal and weapon attacks have -1{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase destroy Frailty.

name: Inertia
text: At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Inertia, then put all cards from your hand and arsenal on the bottom of your deck.
